notes: Direct translation. Grantor and grantee become policy-level assigner and assignee; the permission states no parties of its own, so interiorisation fills them from the policy level (normalisation 0.12 §6.2), equal to RL2's clause subject. rl2:currentDateTime (state.Clock, the snapshot's evaluationTime) is bound to dprod:clock, i.e. sotw.effective_at, not to odrl:dateTime, which due2-core binds to the action time request.at. xsd:dateTimeStamp becomes xsd:dateTime in UTC. The rl2:and becomes two conjunctive constraints. Scenarios 3 and 4 are added; scenario 4 shows that the window is tested at decision time, not at the proposed action time, since RL2 has only one clock.
